# اِنْتَمَيْتَ (intamayta) /in.ta.maj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَمَى (intamā)
# اِنْتَمَيْتِ (intamayti) /in.ta.maj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَمَى (intamā)
